update.draft: Software delivery planning: the field of building software with AI agents; the job is to shape and plan the work before the build. Trigger: the product turns a goal into work items that are built and checked. The field names this work as: shaping before a build (Shape Up: Stop Running in Circles and Ship Work that Matters, Basecamp, 2019, https://basecamp.com/shapeup); story mapping and a thin release a person can test end to end (User Story Mapping, O Reilly, 2014, ISBN 9781491904909, https://www.oreilly.com/library/view/user-story-mapping/9781491904893/); acceptance examples agreed before the build and checked from the outside (Specification by Example, Manning, 2011, https://oreilly.com/library/view/specification-by-example/9781617290084); and the epic and story work hierarchy (Epics, stories, and initiatives, Atlassian, https://www.atlassian.com/agile/project-management/epics-stories-themes). The four sources were checked on the web on 2026-10-24.
